Carriers are offered what the media servers offer (G.711), as before; choosing codecs per carrier returns once it has been tested with real calls. (Live was already fixed by hand on 2026-09-27; this release brings the same fix.)

Storage: Platform → Storage adds object stores such as Zadara, Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage (tested before they are saved), chooses where new files go (for the platform or per tenant), and moves existing files across, several at once within a speed you set, each copy checked and the original kept. Recordings play and download the same wherever they are kept. Each tenant's storage is counted in GB-months for billing.

Call flows: a transfer step can go to a short code (10111, 1023) as well as a full number. Each step's card says what it does (Queue: PBX, Menu: "Press 1…", Transfer to 10111), and a step can be given a name of its own.

Users: someone removed by mistake can be restored (from 0.1.20).

Updates start the SIP edge after the database changes, so installing no longer leaves a short gap in call routing."}
